name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_acute_pancreatitis_inthehistory
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has ever been diagnosed with acute pancreatitis.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has ever been diagnosed with acute pancreatitis at any point in their medical history.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has never been diagnosed with acute pancreatitis at any point in their medical history.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has ever been diagnosed with acute pancreatitis.

name: patient_sex_is_female_now
meaning: Boolean value indicating whether the patient's current sex is female.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's current sex is documented as female.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's current sex is documented as not female (e.g., male or other).
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current sex is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.

name: patient_sex_is_male_now
meaning: Boolean value indicating whether the patient's current sex is male.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's current sex is documented as male.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's current sex is documented as not male (e.g., female or other).
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current sex is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.

name: patient_age_value_recorded_now_in_years
meaning: Numeric value indicating the patient's current age in years.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current age in years is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the patient's current age in years if it is known and documented.

name: duration_of_symptoms_of_acute_pancreatitis_in_hours
meaning: Numeric variable indicating the total duration, in hours, that the patient has had symptoms of acute pancreatitis.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined how long the patient has had symptoms of acute pancreatitis.
when_value: Set to the number of hours the patient has had symptoms of acute pancreatitis.

name: patient_has_symptoms_of_acute_pancreatitis_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has symptoms of acute pancreatitis.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has symptoms of acute pancreatitis.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have symptoms of acute pancreatitis.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has symptoms of acute pancreatitis.

name: patient_is_pregnant_now
meaning: Boolean value indicating whether the patient is currently pregnant.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently pregnant.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently not pregnant.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current pregnancy status is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.

name: patient_is_unable_to_provide_consent_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently unable to provide consent.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently unable to provide consent.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently able to provide consent.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently unable to provide consent.
